title: Sports Trivia Championship
description: Test your sports knowledge across football, cricket, tennis, Olympic games, and basketball milestones.
seoTitle: Sports Trivia Championship Quiz – Football, Cricket & Olympics | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: How big of a sports fan are you? 10 exciting questions covering FIFA World Cups, Wimbledon, Olympic records, and cricket legends.

questions.question: Which nation has won the most FIFA Men's World Cup titles in history (5 titles)?
questions.explanation: Brazil has won five FIFA World Cup tournaments (1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, 2002), more than any other nation.

questions.question: How many players are on the field for one team during a regulation soccer (association football) match?
questions.explanation: A soccer team consists of 11 players on the pitch, including one designated goalkeeper.

questions.question: Who holds the record for the fastest 100-meter sprint in human history at 9.58 seconds?
questions.explanation: Jamaican sprinter Usain Bolt set the 100m world record of 9.58 seconds at the 2009 World Athletics Championships in Berlin.

questions.question: Which Grand Slam tennis tournament is famously played on traditional grass courts?
questions.explanation: Wimbledon, held at the All England Club in London, is the oldest tennis tournament in the world and the only Grand Slam played on grass.

questions.question: What is the maximum 147 break in the game of snooker called?
questions.explanation: A maximum break (147) is achieved by potting 15 reds with 15 blacks, followed by all six colors in sequence.

questions.question: Which cricketer is the only player to have scored 100 international centuries across Test and ODI cricket?
questions.explanation: India's Sachin Tendulkar scored 51 Test centuries and 49 ODI centuries, completing his 100th international century in 2012.

questions.question: In basketball, how many points is a shot made from beyond the three-point arc worth?
questions.explanation: A field goal made from beyond the designated three-point perimeter line counts for exactly 3 points.

questions.question: How long is an official Olympic marathon footrace?
questions.explanation: The official marathon distance was standardized at 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards) for the 1908 London Olympic Games.

questions.question: Which country hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896?
questions.explanation: The first modern Olympic Games took place in Athens, Greece, in April 1896 in honor of the ancient Olympic festival.

questions.question: What is the term in golf for completing a hole in one stroke under par?
questions.explanation: A 'birdie' is one stroke under par on an individual hole, while two strokes under par is an 'eagle'.
